metadata.description: ChefBear for Claude: the ChefBear MCP server and skill for deciding what to order from restaurant menus.

plugins.name: chefbear
plugins.description: Helps you decide what to order from a restaurant menu based on the flavors, mood, appetite and party size you describe, and uses the official ChefBear MCP server to save, find, read and share your ChefBear menus and, with your permission, your taste profile (in the Claude app).
